Broad expensive tails remain unverified. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-quantum-small-2026-11-25 from the ZIP. This command executes all 7 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling Compare a normalized two-state electronic degree of freedom coupled to a nuclear coordinate, short NVE and one nuclear OU bath. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units. Editorial clarification Long first-principles NVE, general multi-orbital orthonormality/SCF errors, general electronic/nuclear baths, canonical equilibration, adiabatic/ergodic certification and materials remain unverified. Adopted numerical method Use analytic BO forces and the declared CP-type action with Verlet/BAOAB; record nuclear heat and fictitious electronic kinetic energy separately. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Finite Dirichlet boxes and central differences; whole-line HO formulas do not isolate finite-wall error. Minimal-basis H2: RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI Compare RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI for H2 at two fixed geometries in the same minimal basis. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function. Editorial clarification Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested. Adopted numerical method Run fixed SCF and diagonalize the4x4 two-electron Hamiltonian using the unchanged explicit H STO-3G contraction.
